The '''''Empyrean''''' was a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] cruiser stationed at [[Cybloc XII/Legends|Cybloc XII]] along with the ''[[Ithor Lady]]''. The warship was destroyed by [[Loronar Corporation/Legends|Loronar Corporation]] [[Needle fighter]]s in the [[Drovian system]].
